## Goal

## What gratitude looks like (NOT theater)
Good:
- "Bad Friday deploy - glad I reverted in standup before pride kept the broken build live"
- "glad the mess taught X" / "glad the old drill was already walked"

BAD:
- "I am so grateful for this principle..."
- Fake thank-you banners

## Rules
- ONLY edit `examples`
- Keep exactly two examples, one sentence each, different scenes
- No contractions in frontmatter (do not, it is, I am)
- No em dashes; hyphen or comma
- No emoji
- Keep existing scene specifics (gym, deploy, clinic, etc.)
- Prefer "glad X held/caught/saved/taught"
